g.text: Neural — a history of drawing less and less
The Kalman filter — the root was engineering
write the world model as equations and predict the next state. It flew on Apollo
the wall — a person has to write those equations
So let the equations be learned
the idea of learning environment dynamics with a neural network
the wall — neither the compute nor the data existed yet
The moment it got a name — World Models
eyes (compress) + memory (predict) + hands (act). Trained inside an imagined world
imagination-based training refined until one config solves 150+ tasks
No need to draw it all — MuZero, JEPA
abandon frame reconstruction and predict only what the decision needs
the side that draws every pixel started producing striking results
Today the family is split internally: draw the pixels, or throw them away
